proposal.hypothesis: For positive target masses, accumulating acceleration directly cancels the per-pair target-mass factor and the final division by target mass. Computing softened reciprocal-distance-cubed with rsqrtf and two multiplies may also reduce per-pair arithmetic. Correctness, especially for extreme masses, must be established by the oracle before any timing comparison.

retained: Accumulate per-target acceleration directly, using cancellation of the positive target mass instead of accumulating force and dividing afterward.
Replace sqrtf plus division by an explicit rsqrtf-based softened reciprocal-distance-cubed calculation.
Retain the direct source loads, target mapping, self-skip, softened distance, Euler update sequence, and exact mass copy.
